svg.title: Figure 2. Connection probability and distance
svg.desc: Figure 2. Line chart, logarithmic vertical axis, of connection probability against distance from 0 to 1000 µm. All pairs together fall steadily, length constant 76 µm over the first 600 µm. Brain pairs fall to a minimum at 340 µm and nerve-cord pairs at 500 µm, then rise again; pairs across the neck start lower and fall with a length constant of 208 µm.
